title: Has anyone seen the monolith recently discovered in area 51? Does this look familiar to anyone?
content: Anyone see the monolith recently discovered on Google maps to area 51? Just randomly popped up. Recently, there was a report of a gigantic monolith that popped up out of nowhere in area 51, apparently it was noticed on Google maps a few days ago! And I got chills when I saw it because it quite literally looks like the very tall building I come out of when I am on the elevators or when I am going up and down the elevators… and right outside of the building , is the large campus or you can walk through the city with a bunch of buildings… I don’t know this may be a reach, but this building looks exactly like what I see in the “Mall world“ …
